from pathlib import Path
p=Path('brand/launch_board.svg')
s=p.read_text()
replacements={
'fill="#20334A"':'fill="#143D59"',
'fill="#D89B3C"':'fill="#F2B84B"',
'>PRODUCT LAUNCH</text>':'>NORTHSTAR LAUNCH DAY</text>',
'>Tools for teams</text>':'>Clarity for every move.</text>',
'translate(72,72)':'translate(112,72)',
}

    if n != 1: raise SystemExit(f'Expected one {old!r}, found {n}')
    s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
